summary: Alpha Compute Corp, a BVI-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange (CIK 0001095435, file 001-40086), furnished a routine Form 6-K on August 20, 2026, solely to update its outstanding share count. As of the close of business August 19, 2026, the company reported 77,492,393 ordinary shares issued and outstanding. CEO Brittany Kaiser signed the report. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed, and the filing carries no special-situation element; the only watch item is future share-count changes tied to the registration statements incorporated by reference.
